comments.content: defragInProgress is set to 1 at the start of VULKAN_INTERNAL_DefragmentMemory but is never cleared back to 0. After the first defrag attempt the flag stays set, so the condition !renderer->defragInProgress in VULKAN_Submit will permanently prevent further defragmentation.

Fence cleanup, empty allocation deallocation and VULKAN_INTERNAL_PerformPendingDestroys are now inside `if (presenting)`. Non-presenting submits will therefore never clean up submitted command buffers, never free empty memory allocations and never perform pending destroys, leading to resource leaks and growing in-flight work.

VULKAN_Submit now returns true unconditionally after the submit path. Present failures from vkQueuePresentKHR and other errors are logged but the function still reports success, masking real submission/present errors from callers.
